title: Customer Radar — weekly prep & quick wins
content:
Purpose: quick notes to run through before 1:1 with AE (Jordan) and SE (Ravi). Keep short, surface risks, ask for blockers, and leave with clear next steps.

Format: start with 3 priority accounts, then quick metrics, then 6-minute deep-dive prompts, then actions. This is a scratchpad — leave TODOs inlined.

TOP ACCOUNTS (priority this week)
1) Brightwave (mid-market SaaS) — renewal Q3, currently P0: latency spikes on embeddings route.
   - Recent: multiple alert incidents (p95 token latency 2.1s -> spike to 4.8s on 2026-03-03). Ops ticket opened.
   - Usage: bursty nightly ETL, heavy embedding usage for search, caching not enabled on customer side.
   - Risk indicators: CS NPS slipped from 9 -> 7; finance asked for spend breakdown.
   - Notes to ask AE: what promise did AE make on latency SLA? Any contractual cadence?
   - Ask SE: feasibility of putting a dedicated cache policy or suggestion to switch to batched endpoints with prewarm. Estimate perf lift.
   - Quick win idea: propose auto-batching + prefix caching for their ETL jobs (pilot for 2 weeks).

2) EmberHealth (enterprise, pilot) — onboarding stalled; data privacy questions pending.
   - Recent: legal sent two redlines around HIPAA/TSA mapping.
   - Blocker: customer wants Private deployment eval; procurement needs estimated infra cost and timeline.
   - Ask AE: did we commit to timeline for Private PoC? Clarify expectations.
   - Ask legal/ops: who owns cost estimate? Tag solutions-eng for ballpark.
   - Action idea: run 30-min scoping call with solutions-eng and infra (this week).

3) NovaRetail (growth) — adoption up, but token spend unexpectedly high.
   - Pattern: devs using long prompts; model size set to 13B where 7B would suffice.
   - Opportunity: Redwood Optimize suggestion: quantization + prompt templates to cut unit cost 22%.
   - Ask AE/SE: permission to run cost experiment on non-prod traffic (A/B test).

QUICK METRICS TO REVIEW (for 1:1)
- MRR coverage for accounts in focus: Brightwave $42k/mo, EmberHealth $18k/mo (pilot), NovaRetail $9k/mo.
- CSAT trends (last 30 days): Brightwave -7 delta, EmberHealth N/A, NovaRetail +2.
- Open tickets >48h: 7 total across these accounts (list in ticket tracker).

6-MIN DEEP DIVE PROMPTS (keep short, ask open questions)
- For AE: "What recent commitments did you make verbally that could impact SLAs or costs?"
- For SE: "If we provision a small private PoC for EmberHealth, what minimal infra and timeline should we quote?"
- For both: "What would a 2-week pilot look like that reduces Brightwave latency risk and proves value?"

NOTES TO SELF / PERSONAL REMINDERS
- Keep tone collaborative; prioritize quick stabilizers before proposing broader architecture changes.
- Bring one clear recommendation per account and a single 'ask' for each AE/SE.
- Capture any timeline commitments in Slack and follow up with short Confluence summary.

OPEN QUESTIONS (need answers before EOD Fri)
- Did AE commit to penalty-free SLA for Brightwave? (Jordan to confirm)
- Who on infra can join the EmberHealth scoping call (Omar/Lina?)
- Are we allowed to run A/B on customer non-prod workloads or do we need explicit consent? (legal)

ACTION ITEMS (explicit, owner, due)
- Jordan (AE): confirm verbal SLA commitments to Brightwave; reply here with quote text. Due: 2026-03-12.
- Ravi (SE): short feasibility note for caching + batching pilot for Brightwave, include rough perf delta % and infra cost estimate. Due: 2026-03-13.
- Kai (me): schedule 30-min scoping with EmberHealth + Solutions (invite Omar + Lina). Include agenda. Due: 2026-03-11.
- Maya (CS): pull ticket list >48h and prioritize by business impact; paste link in this doc. Due: 2026-03-11.
- Legal (cc: Priya): confirm A/B experiment guardrails for NovaRetail non-prod traffic. Due: 2026-03-14.

SLACK / PR/CONFLUENCE REFERENCES TO PASTE DURING CALL
- Confluence: /display/CS/renewal-playbook (link above) — use as canonical renewal steps.
- Slack snippets: #cs-ae-ops pinned doc on escalation; have message ready: "Brightwave latency - gathering commitments and proposing 2-week pilot for batching + prefix cache".
- PR to reference: tools PR#904 (internal script to measure per-route batch effectiveness).

QUICK SCRIPT FOR START OF 1:1 (30s)
- "Quick context: focusing on Brightwave (latency), EmberHealth (private PoC), NovaRetail (cost). Two asks: Jordan confirm SLA text; Ravi quick feasibility write-up. Can we agree to owners and due dates?"

FOLLOW-UP TEMPLATE (post-meeting)
- 1 sentence summary of agreement.
- Owners and due dates (copy from Actions above).
- Link to tickets and Confluence page.
- Ask for quick thumbs-up in Slack thread to make it official.

END NOTES
- Keep this doc as scratchpad; after meeting I will convert final action list to a short Confluence note and ping stakeholders.
- If any new P1 surfaces, escalate to SRE via #pager-escalations and cc AE/SE.

Random scratch ideas (brain dump):
- Could offer Brightwave a short-term burst buffer for night ETL (dedicated smaller instance during ETL window) — needs cost calc.
- EmberHealth: propose NDA -> quick infra scoping -> fixed price PoC to unblock legal.
- NovaRetail: create prompt templates + token budget guardrails in SDK to prevent runaway dev costs.

---
Editable: leave comments inline during meeting.
